name: pitfall-recorder
description: Append a short reusable lesson about the mistake to the repo's existing pitfalls guide, or create docs/known-pitfalls.md and a brief agent-instruction pointer.

inputs.name: bug-report
inputs.description: Original unstructured bug report from the user.

inputs.name: fix-summary
inputs.description: Output from bug-fixer describing defect, location, and changes.

inputs.name: lesson-path
inputs.description: Optional relative path to the pitfalls guide. When omitted, discover from agent instructions or create docs/known-pitfalls.md.

outputs.name: lesson-path
outputs.description: Repo-relative path of the file that received the lesson.

outputs.name: lesson-id
outputs.description: Stable kebab-case slug for the mistake section.
